	<div   data-css_id="tb_fnse813" data-lazy="1" class="themify_builder_row module_row repeat tb_fnse813 clearfix">
	    	    <div class="row_inner col_align_top tf_box tf_w tf_rel" >
			<div  data-lazy="1" class="module_column tb-column col-full first tb_45ip814 tf_box">
	    	    	        <div class="tb-column-inner tf_box tf_w">
<div  class="module module-text tb_ykp3329   " data-lazy="1">
            <div  class="tb_text_wrap">
    <h1 style="text-align: center;">SPORT IS WHAT DRIVES US.</h1>
<hr />
<p style="text-align: center; font-family: museo-sans, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; margin-top: 50px;"><strong>ONE OF THE MAIN TWO ELEMENTS WHICH CREATE NO22 CULTURE IS &#8220;SPORTS&#8221;;<br />A COMMON GROUND FOR LIVES THAT ARE CENTERED AROUND OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES. KITEBOARD IS THE FOCAL POINT WITH THE UNIQUE WIND OF GOKOVA &#8211; KAYAKING, SUP, MOUNTAIN BIKING, MOTOCROSS, CROSSFIT AND YOGA<br />ARE SUCH ARE THE SIDEKICKS.</strong></p>
<hr />
<p style="text-align: center; font-family: freight-display-pro; margin-top: 40px;">You can have a go at kiteboarding with 9 hours beginner course, take advance lessons to improve your technique or rent kiteboard gears to train and enjoy yourself; you can cruise on the beautiful waters of Gökova with the kayaks and SUPs<br />you can rent from the hotel or our school; ride road or mountain bikes on Dalyan-Gökova tours;<br />or join crossfit &#8211; yoga session in Riders&#8217; Inn garden.</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font-family: freight-display-pro;">All you have to do to have detailed information about or join kiteboard lessons or other activities is to contact us!</p>    </div>
</div>
<div  class="module tf_mw module-divider tb_g59u888 solid   " style="border-width: 0px;border-color: #000000;margin-top: 40px;margin-bottom: 20px;" data-lazy="1">
        </div>
	        </div>
	    	</div>
		    </div>
	</div>
	<div  data-css_id="tb_qhof870" data-lazy="1" class="themify_builder_row module_row tb_qhof870 clearfix">
	    	    <div class="row_inner col_align_top tf_box tf_w tf_rel" >
			<div  data-lazy="1" class="module_column tb-column col-full first tb_6ola870 tf_box">
	    	    	        <div class="tb-column-inner tf_box tf_w">
<div  class="module module-text tb_fi90870   " data-lazy="1">
            <div  class="tb_text_wrap">
    <h1 class="no22_eglence" style="text-align: center; font-size: 6rem;">ENTERTAINMENT IS OUR TERRITORY.</h1>
<hr style="height: 4px; background-color: #cd1719;" />
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font-size: 24px!important; line-height: 29px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'freight-display-pro-n3';">The second core element of our habitat is entertainment.</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font-size: 24px!important; line-height: 29px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'freight-display-pro-n3';">At #ridersinnstage, performances take place every day throughout the summer season. DJ sets light up Friday and Saturday nights, while live music fills the stage on other days. During winter, #ridersinnstage moves to Istanbul with special parties and events. Follow our Instagram account to stay updated on the program and make your reservations.</p>
    </div>
</div>
